events.note: Tree lighting 6:00 & 7:50 PM · Home for the Holidays concerts inside (ticketed)
events.blurb: Day two of downtown's free Frontyard Holiday Festival: Dr. Phillips Center's three-acre front yard is a holiday wonderland with snowfall, live performances, a holiday market, Santa's Story Nook, fire pits, and North America's only transportable carillon. Saturday hours run 2 to 10 PM — arrive mid-afternoon with a toddler and stay for the 6 PM tree lighting.
events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center — Seneff Arts Plaza (Frontyard)

events.title: FusionFest — Multicultural Festival at Loch Haven Park
events.note: 9th annual · Thanksgiving weekend
events.blurb: Central Florida's biggest multicultural festival takes over Loch Haven Park for Thanksgiving weekend: food, music, dance, art, and kids' activities from 110+ cultures — all free. Go in the morning with a toddler and graze your way around the world.

events.title: Holiday Spectacular at Garden Theatre
events.note: One night only
events.blurb: A one-night holiday concert in Winter Garden's historic theatre: Opera Orlando, the Orlando Choral Society, and the Winter Garden Community Choir with guest artists — big voices, familiar carols, and Plant Street all lit up outside for dinner before the show.

events.title: Home for the Holidays — Orlando Philharmonic with Michael James Scott
events.note: One day only · Frontyard Holiday Festival runs outside the same day
events.blurb: Broadway powerhouse Michael James Scott comes home for a big holiday pops celebration with the Orlando Philharmonic in Steinmetz Hall — carols, show tunes, and full-orchestra sparkle. Pick the 7:30 PM show for a proper date night, and wander the free Frontyard Holiday Festival on the plaza before or after.

events.title: LEGOLAND Christmas Bricktacular
events.note: Thanksgiving weekend · select dates thru Jan 3
events.blurb: Christmas Bricktacular's Thanksgiving-weekend dates: a 30-foot LEGO Christmas tree, LEGO Santa meet-and-greets, the Festival of Flurries snow show, a Holly Hype dance party, and an interactive light trail — all included with regular admission.

events.title: Now Snowing in Celebration — Opening Night & Tree Lighting
events.note: 28th annual · nightly thru Dec 31 · skating & rides extra
events.blurb: Celebration's 28th annual Now Snowing opens with the tree lighting at 5:30 PM, then 'snow' falls on Market Street at 6, 7, 8, and 9 PM, with strolling carolers and Santa photos. Admission and parking are free — catch the 6 PM snowfall with a toddler; it runs nightly through December 31.

events.title: SeaWorld Christmas Celebration
events.note: Select dates Nov 6 – Jan 4
events.blurb: SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration (on now through Jan 4) stays open late the Saturday after Thanksgiving: millions of lights, Sesame Street Land decked out for Christmas with Elmo and friends, Rudolph meet-and-greets, and a Winter Wonderland on Ice skating show — all included with regular admission. Go for the daytime and early-evening shows with a toddler.

events.title: Winter Garden Farmers Market
events.note: Weekly on Saturdays
events.blurb: One of the largest farmers markets in Florida — 100+ vendors, live music, baked goods, flowers, and local food around the downtown pavilion. Pair it with the Plant Street splash fountain for a full Saturday morning.

events.title: Winter Haven Farmers Market
events.note: Rain or shine · pet-friendly
events.blurb: 40-plus vendors, live music, and snacks in downtown Winter Haven — a Saturday-morning wander with room for a toddler to roam.

events.title: Celebration Farmers Market
events.note: Weekly on Sundays
events.blurb: A Sunday-morning market along Front Street in Celebration's storybook Town Center — farm-fresh produce, handmade goods, and local vendors, with lakeside paths and porch rocking chairs for a slow family morning.

events.title: Frontyard Holiday Festival at Dr. Phillips Center
events.note: Sunday movie night: Rudolph 6:30 PM · The Muppet Christmas Carol 7:45 PM
events.blurb: Sunday at downtown's free Frontyard Holiday Festival adds lawn movies — Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer at 6:30 PM and The Muppet Christmas Carol at 7:45 PM — on top of the snowfall, Santa's Story Nook, holiday market, and fire pits. Festival hours are 2 to 10 PM; the early movie is the toddler pick.
events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center — Seneff Arts Plaza (Frontyard)

events.title: FusionFest — Multicultural Festival at Loch Haven Park
events.note: 9th annual · day two
events.blurb: Central Florida's biggest multicultural festival takes over Loch Haven Park for Thanksgiving weekend: food, music, dance, art, and kids' activities from 110+ cultures — all free. Go in the morning with a toddler and graze your way around the world.

events.title: LEGOLAND Christmas Bricktacular
events.note: Thanksgiving weekend · select dates thru Jan 3
events.blurb: Christmas Bricktacular's Thanksgiving-weekend dates: a 30-foot LEGO Christmas tree, LEGO Santa meet-and-greets, the Festival of Flurries snow show, a Holly Hype dance party, and an interactive light trail — all included with regular admission.

events.title: Rocket Launch: Falcon 9 — Cygnus NG-25 to the Space Station
events.price: Viewing incl. w/ KSC admission · free from the coast
events.note: Liftoff targeted NET 10:49 AM ET from SLC-40 · date/time can still slip — check again the day before
events.blurb: SpaceX's Falcon 9 returns to Florida flight carrying Northrop Grumman's Cygnus XL cargo ship to the International Space Station — NASA's CRS-25 resupply run. Liftoff is targeted for 10:49 AM ET, right in family hours: watch from the Visitor Complex viewing areas (included with admission) or free from the coast.

events.title: Wekiva Island Winter Wonderland — Opening Day & Tree Lighting
events.timeLabel: Holiday Market 1:00 – 5:00 PM · Tree Lighting 6:30 – 9:00 PM
events.note: Runs thru Dec 25 · Santa's Workshop on weekends
events.blurb: The riverside Winter Wonderland opens in Longwood with an afternoon holiday market, then the Christmas Tree Forest lights up at 6:30 PM — plus nightly 'snow' flurries and Santa's Workshop. Admission is just $5; opening day is the festive pick.

events.title: Winter Park Old Fashioned Christmas Cruise
events.venue: Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour Docks
events.note: Tickets on sale Nov 17 at 9 AM — they sell out
events.blurb: The first sailing of the season for Original Orlando Tours' beloved Christmas cruise: about 80 minutes gliding the Winter Park chain of lakes under the lights, with Christmas music, caroling, holiday trivia, and readings of 'Twas the Night Before Christmas. A Monday-night date with real old-Florida charm — set an alarm for the November 17 on-sale.

events.title: Asian Lantern Festival: Into the Wild — Sensory Night
events.note: Sensory night — adjusted sound & lighting · online only, no walk-up tickets
events.blurb: A sensory-friendly night at the zoo's glowing lantern walk: adjusted sound and lighting along the ¾-mile stroller-friendly loop of illuminated animals and the new solar-system display. Book the 6 PM entry — dark enough for the lights, early enough for a toddler bedtime.

events.title: Death Becomes Her — Broadway in Orlando
events.note: Florida debut · runs Dec 1–6
events.blurb: The Tony-winning musical comedy based on the 1992 film makes its Florida debut downtown: rival frenemies Madeline Ashton and Helen Sharp drink a magic potion and get more youth than they bargained for. A big, campy Steinmetz-week date night at the Walt Disney Theater.
events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center — Walt Disney Theater

events.title: Live Trivia at Crooked Can
events.note: Weekly on Tuesdays
events.blurb: Live team trivia on the brewery's main patio every Tuesday — four rounds, a movie-of-the-week halftime quiz, and a Jeopardy-style final, with gift-card prizes. Order from the Plant St. Market counters and make it dinner-and-a-game.

events.title: Wiggles & Giggles Toddler Storytime
events.note: Weekly program — confirm on the library site before you go
events.blurb: The area's only storytime built specifically for ages 1–3: wiggles, rhymes, and short books at true toddler attention-span length, every Tuesday at the Lake Wales library.

events.title: Death Becomes Her — Broadway in Orlando
events.note: Florida debut · runs Dec 1–6
events.blurb: The Tony-winning musical comedy based on the 1992 film makes its Florida debut downtown: rival frenemies Madeline Ashton and Helen Sharp drink a magic potion and get more youth than they bargained for. A big, campy Steinmetz-week date night at the Walt Disney Theater.
events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center — Walt Disney Theater

events.title: Preschool Storytime — Haines City Public Library
events.note: Weekly on Wednesdays · library posts changes on Facebook — confirm before you go · Thanksgiving week — confirm before you go
events.blurb: Haines City's own preschool storytime: stories and songs for ages 2–5 at the library on 6th Street every Wednesday morning — about a half-mile from the sister-in-law's house, and an easy meet-in-the-middle outing.

events.title: Christmas in the Park with the Morse Museum
events.note: 48th annual · windows lit at 6:15 PM · bring blankets/chairs
events.blurb: Winter Park's beloved free holiday evening: seven century-old Tiffany leaded-glass windows from the Morse Museum light up in Central Park's north section while the Bach Festival Choir and Brass Ensemble perform. Arrive early, bring a blanket — the windows stay lit until 8:30 PM.

events.title: Death Becomes Her — Broadway in Orlando
events.note: Florida debut · runs Dec 1–6

events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center — Walt Disney Theater

events.title: Holiday on the Drive — College Park
events.note: Annual College Park holiday street festival
events.blurb: College Park closes Edgewater Drive for its annual holiday street party: Santa, a snow slide, live carolers, carriage rides, food trucks, and an artisan village. Free and family-friendly — go early in the evening with a toddler.

events.title: Preschool Storytime — Windermere Library
events.note: Weekly on Thursdays · no registration
events.blurb: A weekly preschool storytime at the little Windermere branch on Main Street: picture books, songs, and rhymes that build early literacy, designed for ages 3–5. Two minutes from home — the perfect standing Thursday plan.

events.title: Toddler Time — Haines City Public Library
events.note: Weekly on Thursdays · library posts changes on Facebook — confirm before you go
events.blurb: A Thursday-morning toddler session at the Haines City library — rhymes, movement, and short stories sized for the littlest listeners, a few blocks from the sister-in-law's house.

events.title: Free Friday Evening at the Morse Museum
events.venue: Charles Hosmer Morse Museum of American Art
events.note: Free Fridays Nov–Apr
events.blurb: The Morse Museum's free Friday evenings run all season: admission is free from 4 to 8 PM, with the galleries — including the Tiffany Chapel and the world's most comprehensive Tiffany collection — open late. Pair it with dinner on Park Avenue for an easy Winter Park date, or bring the family before bedtime.

events.title: Light Up Winter Garden — 39th Annual
events.note: Rain or shine · light show repeats Dec 5 & 6, 6–9 PM
events.blurb: Downtown Winter Garden flips the switch on the season: the tree and City Hall light up at 6:15 PM, with a children's snow area at the Downtown Pavilion, stilt walkers, character meet-and-greets, and photo stations along Plant Street. Free and festive — the 6 PM hour is the toddler sweet spot.

events.title: The Nutcracker — Orlando Ballet (Opening Weekend)
events.note: Also Sat Dec 5, 7:00 PM & Sun Dec 6, 2:00 PM · children must be 2+
events.blurb: Opening night of Orlando Ballet's Nutcracker in Steinmetz Hall — the full Tchaikovsky score, snowflakes, and the Sugar Plum Fairy in Orlando's grandest hall. The designated family-friendly performances start Dec 12, so opening weekend is the grown-ups' date-night pick.

events.title: Tree Lighting Celebration at Lake Eola
events.note: Music at the amphitheater from 5:30 PM
events.blurb: Downtown Orlando lights its big Lake Eola tree: live music at the amphitheater from 5:30 PM, a main stage show at 7 leading to the lighting, plus food trucks, snowfall, a Merry Market of 30+ vendors, and Santa photos. Go early and leave after the lighting for a toddler-friendly version.

events.title: Asian Lantern Festival: Into the Wild
events.note: Online only — no walk-up tickets · family 4-pack $89.96
events.blurb: The zoo's glowing nighttime lantern walk is in full swing: a ¾-mile stroller-friendly loop of giant illuminated animals and a new solar-system display. Book the 6 PM entry — dark enough for the lights, early enough for a toddler bedtime.

events.title: Christmas Festival at Southern Hill Farms — Opening Weekend
events.note: Opening weekend · also Sun Dec 6 · advance tickets online
events.blurb: The blueberry farm turns Christmassy for its 3rd annual festival: snow showers, Santa visits, a Merry Market, the kids' Fun Zone, and a holiday movie at 6:30 PM. Afternoon hours keep it toddler-friendly — go at 1 PM and stay for the first snow shower. Also runs Sunday.

events.title: Christmas at Hamlin: A Festival of Holiday Traditions
events.note: 25-ft tree · Santa photos · cookie decorating
events.blurb: Hamlin's big neighborhood Christmas night on the green: a 25-foot tree lighting with caroling at 6 PM, photos with Santa, holiday crafts and reindeer food, cookie decorating, and letters to Santa. Right in Horizon West — an easy, festive evening close to home.

events.title: Frontyard Holiday Festival at Dr. Phillips Center
events.note: Tree lighting 6:00 & 7:50 PM
events.blurb: Saturday at downtown's free Frontyard Holiday Festival: Dr. Phillips Center's three-acre front yard is a holiday wonderland with snowfall, live performances, a holiday market, Santa's Story Nook, fire pits, and North America's only transportable carillon. Hours run 2 to 10 PM — arrive mid-afternoon with a toddler and stay for the 6 PM tree lighting.
events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center — Seneff Arts Plaza (Frontyard)

events.title: Holiday Night Market & Golf Cart Parade — Winter Garden
events.note: Santa photos & stage entertainment at the market
events.blurb: An evening holiday market at the Downtown Pavilion with Santa photos and stage entertainment — and at 6 PM the beloved golf cart parade rolls down Plant Street, hundreds of carts decked in lights and tinsel. A very Winter Garden Saturday night, done by 8.

events.title: Home Depot Kids Workshop: Holiday Train
events.note: First Saturday monthly · register ahead — kits go fast
events.blurb: Free monthly in-store build: this month kids assemble and decorate a wooden Holiday Train, with a workshop apron, collectible pin, and certificate to take home. Officially geared to ages 5–12, but little builders join in with a grown-up on hammer duty — register ahead to hold a kit.

events.title: LEGOLAND Christmas Bricktacular
events.note: Select dates thru Jan 3
events.blurb: Christmas Bricktacular: a 30-foot LEGO Christmas tree, LEGO Santa meet-and-greets, the Festival of Flurries snow show, a Holly Hype dance party, and an interactive light trail — all included with regular admission.

events.title: Now Snowing in Celebration
events.note: Nightly thru Dec 31 · skating & rides extra
events.blurb: Celebration's 28th annual Now Snowing: 'snow' falls on Market Street at 6, 7, 8, and 9 PM, with strolling carolers, an ice rink, and Santa photos in the storybook Town Center. Admission and parking are free — catch the 6 PM snowfall with a toddler.

events.title: SeaWorld Christmas Celebration
events.note: Select dates Nov 6 – Jan 4
events.blurb: SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration on a Saturday: millions of lights, Sesame Street Land decked out for Christmas with Elmo and friends, Rudolph meet-and-greets, and a Winter Wonderland on Ice skating show — all included with regular admission. Go for the daytime and early-evening shows with a toddler.

events.title: Winter Garden Christmas Parade
events.note: Route: Dillard St north to Plant St, west through downtown
events.blurb: A hometown Saturday-morning Christmas parade through downtown Winter Garden — bands, floats, and Santa rolling down Plant Street. Claim a sidewalk spot near the start for the easiest toddler viewing, then stay for the farmers market.

events.title: Winter Park “Ye Olde Hometown” Christmas Parade
events.note: 74th annual · 80+ groups, bands & Santa
events.blurb: The 74th Ye Olde Hometown Christmas Parade rolls down Park Avenue with 80+ organizations, marching bands, and Santa — a classic Saturday-morning parade in Winter Park's prettiest setting. Arrive early for a front-row curb spot in Central Park.

events.title: Frontyard Holiday Festival at Dr. Phillips Center
events.note: Sunday movie night: The Year Without a Santa Claus 6:30 PM · Elf 7:45 PM
events.blurb: Sunday at downtown's free Frontyard Holiday Festival adds lawn movies — The Year Without a Santa Claus at 6:30 PM and Elf at 7:45 PM — on top of the snowfall, Santa's Story Nook, holiday market, and fire pits. Festival hours are 2 to 10 PM; the early movie is the toddler pick.
events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center — Seneff Arts Plaza (Frontyard)

events.title: Holiday Pops in Winter Park — Orlando Philharmonic
events.note: Bring a blanket & picnic · no tents or pets
events.blurb: The Orlando Philharmonic's free Holiday Pops on the Central Park main stage — Christmas favorites under the lights on Park Avenue. Bring a blanket and a picnic; a gentle first orchestra evening for a little kid, and an easy early night.

events.title: Homegrown Market at Hamlin
events.note: 1st & 3rd Sundays · Cars & Coffee this Sunday
events.blurb: A neighborhood market morning in Hamlin with live music, a yoga class on the green, food vendors, and local makers — an easy Sunday outing in Horizon West.

events.title: LEGOLAND Christmas Bricktacular
events.note: Select dates thru Jan 3
events.blurb: Christmas Bricktacular: a 30-foot LEGO Christmas tree, LEGO Santa meet-and-greets, the Festival of Flurries snow show, a Holly Hype dance party, and an interactive light trail — all included with regular admission.

events.title: Bok Tower Gardens + Hammock Hollow
events.note: Carillon concerts 1 & 3 PM
events.blurb: Shady Olmsted-designed gardens built around a 205-foot Singing Tower, with Hammock Hollow Children's Garden — water play, a fairy garden, and sand and climbing play under the oaks. One of Florida's prettiest toddler days out.

events.title: Cocoa Beach Pier Day
events.timeLabel: Beach all day · pier from 11:00 AM
events.note: Go early for calmer water
events.blurb: The classic Space Coast beach day: an 800-foot pier over the Atlantic with restaurants, rentals, and showers right at the sand. Morning is the toddler sweet spot — gentler waves, easier parking — and if a rocket launches, you'll see it from your beach blanket.

events.title: Half-Price Tuesdays at Cinépolis Hamlin
events.blurb: Dinner-and-a-movie without the weekend markup: Cinépolis' luxury theater at Hamlin (recliners, dine-in service) cuts ticket prices in half every Tuesday. Pair with dinner in Hamlin Town Center.

events.title: Kennedy Space Center + Planet Play
events.timeLabel: Daily 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM · arrive at opening
events.blurb: Stand under the space shuttle Atlantis, then let your toddler loose in Planet Play — a multi-story indoor playground of planets and climbing nets built for little kids while you grab a coffee. Mostly indoors and stroller-friendly; under-3s are free.

events.title: Plant Street Market & Crooked Can Evening
events.blurb: The no-planning-needed downtown date: about 20 food and artisan vendors inside Plant Street Market, Crooked Can's taps at the center, and big patio seating under the lights. Go Friday or Saturday for the best scene, then walk Plant Street after.

events.title: Stories in Stone: Primal — Bok Tower Gardens
events.note: Adults $25 · kids 5 & under free · exhibit through Jan 3
events.blurb: Monumental balanced-stone sculptures tucked along the garden paths turn a stroll into a treasure hunt — and the 3-year-old gets in free. Pair it with the Hammock Hollow children's garden on site, and go early: the gardens close at 5 PM.

events.title: The Florida Aquarium
events.note: Bring swim gear for the splash pad
events.blurb: Sharks, penguins, and a wetlands trail under a glass dome — plus The Splash Pad, an outdoor water-play area made for toddlers. Under-3s get in free, and it's an easy pair with lunch in Sparkman Wharf next door.
